name: scoRch.generator: Spatiotemporal Classification of Regional Compound Heatwaves
description: R implementation of SCORCH, the method of Bouhamad and Najibi for finding regionally extensive compound heatwaves in gridded daily maximum temperature: local heatwaves at every grid cell, regionally extensive days, DBSCAN clusters, principal-component ellipses with temperature-weighted centroids, four compound-event types, and power-law and log-Gaussian Cox process models. One configuration file and one function run the complete workflow on ERA5 or prepared daily maximum temperature.
